name: Loaded Mexican Rice
description:
A tex-mex style mexican rice with beans and meat. Adding the beans and meat take it from a side
dish to good good burrito filling.

ingredients.name: Long grain white rice
ingredients.originalText: 1 Cup uncooked long grain white rice

ingredients.name: Black or pinto beans
ingredients.originalText: 1 Can of black or pinto beans

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 1 Cup uncooked long grain white rice; 1/2 Cup frozen peas; 1/2 Cup frozen corn; 2 Caned adobo chilies chopped; 5 Tbsp tomato paste; 1 Can of black or pinto beans; 1/2 Cup ground meat (optional); 1/4 Onion diced (optional). Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Set out the bowls, pans, measuring tools, and any baking equipment named in the steps below. Wash any fresh produce before use. Keep raw eggs, meat, and their utensils separate from ready-to-eat food.
Pore enough neutral oil in a large pan to cover the bottom entirely, and turn on to medium heat.
Once pan is hot add rice, brake up the rice to ensue there are no clumps.
Add tomato paste and chilies to the pan, mix until rice is coated add water if needed.
Strain and add the beans, corn, and peas; if you are adding meat and or onion do so now.
Mix well, ensue peas and corn thaw.
Serve hot as either a burrito or bowl with your choice of fillings/toppings.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.
